title: ursinia brachyloba
intro: Ursinia brachyloba, commonly known as the yellow daisy, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ursinia brachyloba include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
